method: Independent label cashflows and close-risk reconstruction; augmented least-squares Ridge; all folds, predictions, utility denominators, rankings, bins and paired MSE bootstrap intervals. Authenticated inputs; no strategy accounts.
limitations: Conditional on executed and complete events for monetary labels.
Equal-count per-fold selection is retrospective and not executable.
MSE block intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons; all development observations have been seen.
